contentSections.heading: At 30, my first Korean skincare routine
paragraphs: Until now we got by on good looks alone. I had never even used sunscreen, and when I turned 30 I decided to take this seriously: I put together my first Korean skincare routine.
I received three Abib products sent by YesStyle, an online store that sells imported cosmetics. They are Korean brands, and the store itself declares them to be authentic.

This article is my first contact with the three of them, recorded in the video in this article: what it's like to apply them, the texture, the scent and what I felt when I took the patch off. I can't promise skin results on the first day. I'll use them over the coming weeks and come back here to tell you what changed.

contentSections.heading: The three Abib products I received
paragraphs: The routine has one product for each area: eyes, face and lips. The details below come from each product's official page on YesStyle; the impressions are mine.

contentSections.heading: Hydrogel eye patch: cool on the skin (and I put it on backwards)
paragraphs: The first thing I noticed is the best: the patch is cool. It comes in a jar of 60, and the brand says the textured surface helps it not slip.

I'll admit I put the first one on wrong. I flipped it, flipped it back, tried it the other way and thought it sat better like that, but honestly, I couldn't feel any difference between the sides. If you've never used one either, don't worry: what matters is that it sits snugly under your eyes without touching the eye itself.

Over time the patch gets thinner, as if it were disappearing. That doesn't mean your skin absorbed all the hydrogel; it's the gel releasing what's inside while it stays there, sealed, without evaporating.
The packaging says to take it off after 10 to 15 minutes. In the video I left it on for about 20, because I was doing the rest of the routine. Follow the label. And it's not meant to be slept in.
bullets: When I took it off: my skin felt dry to the touch, and I could clearly see the shape of where the patch had been;
Feel: cool as soon as it touches the skin;
What the brand promises: to brighten the area and soften a tired look, with PDRN, retinal and caffeine. I can only judge that with continued use.

contentSections.heading: Booster Crème 2.5: an ointment texture that turns to velvet
paragraphs: While the patch did its thing, I applied the cream. It comes out of the tube with an ointment-like texture: you smooth it on and feel it glide over your skin.
The part I liked most comes after spreading it: the skin gets a velvety feel, as if it turned into velvet on the spot. And it spreads really well.

In the formula, Abib highlights PDRN and Volufiline (an ingredient used to give a plumping feel), along with retinal, peptides, niacinamide and caffeine. Abib recommends the cream for firmness and fine lines, which means long-term work.
bullets: Where to apply: face and neck, with light patting to help absorption, as the brand directs;

contentSections.heading: Lip Mask Glazed Jelly: a candy scent that isn't overpowering
paragraphs: Last, the lip mask. It comes with a little spatula, and the texture is a gel, similar to the eye patch.
It has a candy-like scent, but it isn't sickly. Anyone who follows me knows I have a problem with strong smells, and this one didn't bother me.
The brand says to use a thin layer during the day for shine and hydration, or a generous layer before bed as an overnight mask.

contentSections.heading: PDRN and retinal, demystified: why the effect is gentle
paragraphs: The big thing about Korean skincare is that the products are designed for long-term use. Girl, you just turned 30: this is only the beginning. For the rest of your life you'll need a skin care routine.

In the video I said retinoic acid, but the right name for the ingredient in the patch and the cream is retinal (or retinaldehyde). It's a vitamin A derivative, in the same family as retinol, and the skin converts it into retinoic acid. The action is more gradual, which is why I won't start peeling just because I began using it.

PDRN is an ingredient made of DNA fragments that has become a craze in Korean cosmetics; Abib uses it in products aimed at firmness. In the lip mask, Abib states that the PDRN comes from centella asiatica and ginkgo biloba.
bullets: Gentle effect: don't expect a change on the first day or in the first week; the benefit comes with consistency;
Sunscreen in the daytime: if you use retinal at night, you need sunscreen during the day. For someone who has never used it, like me, this is the first habit to build;
Pregnancy and breastfeeding: vitamin A derivatives call for medical advice before use;
Sensitive skin: if it stings or turns red, use it less often and see a dermatologist.

contentSections.heading: My beginner's night routine, step by step
paragraphs: The order I followed in the video fits into an ordinary evening, without the ten-step marathon the internet associates with Korean skincare:
bullets: Step 1, eyes: with a clean face, I put the hydrogel patch under my eyes;
Step 2, face and neck: while the patch works, I pat on the Booster Crème;
Step 3, lips: one layer of the lip mask with the spatula;
Step 4, removing the patch: after 10 to 15 minutes, as the packaging says;
Total time: about 15 minutes, most of it waiting with the patch on.

contentSections.heading: Frequently asked questions
bullets: How long should I leave the Abib hydrogel patch on? The packaging says to remove it after 10 to 15 minutes. It's not meant to be slept in.

What is PDRN? It's an ingredient made of DNA fragments, widely used in Korean cosmetics that, according to the brands, promise firmness. In the Abib lip mask, the brand states a plant origin (centella asiatica and ginkgo biloba).

Is retinal the same as retinoic acid? No. Retinal is a vitamin A derivative that the skin converts into retinoic acid. That's why its action is more gradual, and it calls for sunscreen during the day.
Does the Abib lip mask have a strong scent? It has a candy-like scent. I'm sensitive to strong smells, and this one didn't bother me.

Where do I use the CECILIA010 code? In the Reward Code field at checkout. It gives 5% off your first purchase and 2% off the following ones, and stacks with the coupon you enter in the Coupon Code field.
